senses.gloss: रेख m. 1. A line, a streak, सरसां पश्य वयस्य रागरेखाम् Mal.iii.; 2. a row, a series; 3. the prime meridian drawn from Lankā to Meru through Ujjayinī; 4. fullness, satisfaction; 5. deceit; 6. drawing, delineating, तथापि तस्या लावण्यं रेखया किंचिदन्वितम् Sak.vi.; 7. a small portion, a jot, R.i.17.

रेखा f. 1. A line, a streak, सरसां पश्य वयस्य रागरेखाम् Mal.iii.; 2. a row, a series; 3. the prime meridian drawn from Lankā to Meru through Ujjayinī; 4. fullness, satisfaction; 5. deceit; 6. drawing, delineating, तथापि तस्या लावण्यं रेखया किंचिदन्वितम् Sak.vi.; 7. a small portion, a jot, R.i.17.
रेखा-अंश m. a degree of longitude.
रेखा-अन्तर n. distance east or west from the first meridian.
रेखा-आकर a. formed in lines, striped.
